svg.text: BREAKING TYPE_CHANGED [order_id]: column data type changed (int64 -> string)

WARNING DISTRIBUTION_SHIFT [amount]: median moved beyond the deterministic baseline threshold (12.0 -> 1200.0)
WARNING CATEGORY_DRIFT [status]: label-free category cardinality or frequency profile changed (3 -> 4)
INFO COLUMN_ADDED [new_flag]: column was added (— -> bool)
